compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Write integration tests for schema_version=2 consumer reads
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-verifier-consumer-migration.sh that asserts each migrated consumer correctly reads P1 from schema_version=2 response. Tests must fail before T3 updates the consumers.

## Test Cases (one per consumer)
1. sprint Phase G consumer: given schema_version=2 JSON with P1=PASS → consumer reads PASS (not undefined)
2. debug-everything consumer: given schema_version=2 JSON with P1=FAIL → consumer halts
3. preplanning consumer: given schema_version=2 JSON with P1=INCONCLUSIVE → consumer escalates
4. Backward-compat: given schema_version=1 JSON (no P1 field) → consumer reads overall_verdict with deprecation warning

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-verifier-consumer-migration.sh exits non-zero (RED — consumers not yet migrated)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-verifier-consumer-migration.sh

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S1B/T1)
